checks.title: Confirm cost goal and owners
checks.instructions: Record the named platform, service and finance owners, desired cost outcome, affected service and excluded actions. A saving is not verified until comparable billing and health evidence exist.

checks.title: Bind exact cloud scope
checks.instructions: Record provider, account, service, resource, environment, region, currency, billing basis, allocation/tag policy and source cutoffs. Keep credits, one-time charges and commitment changes separate from usage or price effects.

checks.title: Agree on comparable cost evidence
checks.instructions: Define equal baseline/current periods and resource-level post-change verification periods, workload comparability, price and discount treatment, data freshness and rounding. An export supports read-only review; incomplete or changing basis blocks a verified savings claim.

checks.title: Agree on change and health gates
checks.instructions: Name IaC owner, repository/state, approval authority, deployment environment, rollback route and service health thresholds. An optimization proposal cannot deploy itself; a green plan is not an applied change.

checks.title: Bind three distinct Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect and reuse or propose authorized Cloud Cost Analyst, Engineering Delivery Coordinator and Finance Analyst Crews. Verify selected skills and source boundaries; record three Crew IDs, their owners and exact output artifact types.

checks.title: Test actual source reads
checks.instructions: Read representative authorized billing/usage, resource/health, IaC/deployment and finance records or exports. Record account, resource, source IDs, period coverage, observed times and missing sources; a provider name is not a connected account.

checks.title: Validate both handoffs
checks.instructions: Save actual cloud-cost-review/v1, cloud-change-review/v1 and cloud-savings-readout/v1 paths. Run blocking validators in order, matching account, service, resource, environment, candidate and change IDs. Confirm a wrong resource, unapproved deployment or unsupported verified saving blocks its consumer. Save Crew run IDs and validator output.

checks.title: Review the Builder plan
checks.instructions: Show Crew reuse or creation, source access, cost, IaC and finance steps, artifact paths, validators, approval boundaries, health/retest rule, run budget and activation choice to the owners before configuration.

checks.title: Run one bounded case manually
checks.instructions: Use one authorized account/service/resource and two comparable cost periods. Record all three Crew run IDs, artifact paths, validator results, owner review and pending or verified finance state. A fictional fixture never completes setup. Keep the route manual when a source or validator is missing.

checks.title: Choose manual or recurring policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused schedule/trigger with timezone, source freshness, cloud API limits, concurrency, retries, budget and notifications. Completing setup does not apply infrastructure, book savings or enable recurrence.
